MERN Stack Development Intern – Infoziant Dec 2025 
- Completed a MERN Stack Development Internship at Infoziant, gaining practical experience in full-stack web development. 
- Constructed DishDash Smart Food Delivery & Order Tracking Platform using MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js, 
implementing asset tracking, CRUD operations, and RESTful APIs. Built responsive user interfaces and integrated database mana gement

PROJECTS 
ASKCODZZ- PROGRAMMING LANGUAGES LEARNING CHATBOT GitHub Mar 2026 
Developed an AI-based chatbot designed to help users learn programming languages interactively. It uses the Gemini API to generate intelligent 
and real -time responses to user queries. The frontend, built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, provides a simple chat interface, while t he 
backend, developed in Python, handles user inputs and API communication. The chatbot acts as a virtual coding assistant, help ing users 
understand programming concepts and syntax effectively. 
multilingual language analysis. 
REBOOST – MOBILE RECHARGE MADE SIMPLE GitHub Jan 2026 
Developed a MERN stack web application that streamlines mobile recharge services with secure authentication, operator - wise plan browsing, 
and instant recharge processing. Built scalable REST APIs using Node.js and Express.js for user, recharge, and payment manage ment; leveraged 
MongoDB for transaction storage and analytics, delivering real-time recharge status updates and an intuitive, mobile-friendly interface. 
STEM AI – GAMIFIED STEM LEARNING & CAREER GUIDANCE PLATFORM GitHub Dec 2025 
Built a full-stack AI-powered education platform using React.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and Tailwind CSS, featuring gamified STEM learning 
through interactive quizzes, challenges, XP -based progression, badges, streaks, and leaderboards. Integrated a multi-agent AI system for skill 
profiling, career matching, personalized learning roadmaps, and AI mentor guidance using LangGraph/LangChain with Gemini/OpenAI APIs, 
while tracking student performance through real-time analytics and personalized dashboards. 
ACHIEVEMENTS

problem-solving, and programming skills.

Selected among 300+ teams for developing an innovative industry-focused solution, teamwork, and problem-solving abilities.
